column1: # Burn-down list of the unpinned-response completeness rule (INV-T-27400, INV-AC-27399).
# Each data line names a response of a <directory>/openapi.yaml operation that has no operation_response row in
# <directory>/required-identifiers.tsv yet. The list can only shrink: spectral/check-required-identifiers.py fails a line that is
# new since the base commit, a line whose response now has a row or no longer exists, and a duplicate or malformed line.
# Columns, tab separated: directory, operation_id, status, owner_task (the owning service's later pinning task, or unassigned).
# A task that pins a listed response adds its row and deletes its line in the same merge request.
# Sorted by directory, operation_id, status. Generated from origin/main 67e11c3e0879e89e38ed706d8c43e960faca515f.
